note: Separate 6–7 PM local-time events across Asia (Shanghai), Europe (Berlin), and Americas (Pacific). Kiomet, Openfront, Netquel and MK48.io are first-wave approved templates. Mazean, Turnfight and Voxmaxa are explicitly paused pending enough players/volunteer hosts; do not falsely advertise them as active. Per-server consent is required before Discord publishing.
